authority: Named output-root grants per ADR-REV1XX-PRODUCER-OUTPUT-ROOT-001. A root is granted by an owner to an enumerated producer and write class for pinned source bytes. Legacy grants without write_class authorize only the default class. No grant authorizes deletion, and revocation is a retained state rather than a deletion of the record.
